families.axis: faint bodily unease → outright physical misery

members.tone: The plain cover term, working equally for the thing that gives the discomfort and the body that feels it, which is what keeps it so flat.
Blunt and unspecific about the body feeling wrong, naming neither the site nor the sharpness of what is felt.

members.tone: The colloquial counterpart to *bad*, looser and more offhand about the same felt discomfort.
members._gloss: feeling physical discomfort or pain (‘tough’ is occasionally used colloquially for ‘bad’)

The heavier word for that same effect, putting the discomfort on the scale of hurt rather than annoyance.
Gathers the discomfort into a whole bodily condition instead of a single sensation, so it reads as total rather than local.
A degree past *miserable* on the same misery — abject, with no dignity left to the body it describes.
The faintest of these: a bodily unsettledness that has not hardened into pain, more a hint than a hurt.

members.tone: Locates the discomfort in looming danger or trouble rather than in the flesh, and its mildness is exactly what makes it sound like a warning.
members._gloss: uncomfortable because of possible danger or trouble

members.tone: Understated almost to neutrality — the same approval as *broad-minded* with the force stripped out of it.
Sounds a note of magnanimity, as though the openness were generosity of spirit and not merely fairness.
The most expansive term here, praising openness as a governing principle rather than a reaction to any particular view.
The coolest praise in the set — it credits forbearance, granting a view room instead of welcoming it.
Formal and elevated, praising a sweep wide enough that no narrow attachment survives it.
members._gloss: free from provincial prejudices or attachments

members.tone: Praise with defiance in it — the openness is a refusal of dogma, not the mild receptiveness of *open-minded*.
members._gloss: unwilling to accept authority or dogma (especially in religion)

members.tone: Bookish and clinical, naming the position where *free-thinking* cheers for it.
members._gloss: unwilling to accept authority or dogma (especially in religion)

members.tone: Defined by what it withholds, measuring out its approval as an absence of rigidity rather than any positive warmth.
members._gloss: unwilling to accept authority or dogma (especially in religion)

members.tone: The longer, stiffer twin of *undogmatic*, its extra syllable pulling it further from anything conversational.
members._gloss: unwilling to accept authority or dogma (especially in religion)

members.tone: Plain and unpretentious, asking no more than a willingness to hear the new idea out.

families.axis: neutral naming of rules against unfair dealing → emphatic praise for dealing fairly
families._definition: free from favoritism or self-interest or bias or deception; conforming with established standards or

members.tone: Plain, unarguable approval - it certifies that no favoritism or deception got in, without the weight of principle *just* carries.
members._gloss: free from favoritism or self-interest or bias or deception; conforming with established st

members._gloss: free from favoritism or self-interest or bias or deception; conforming with established st

members.tone: Purely classificatory - it says what a law or regulation is built to protect trade from, and commends no one.
members._gloss: of laws and regulations; designed to protect trade and commerce from unfair business pract

members.tone: Technical and as neutral as *antimonopoly*, marking a regulation's protective purpose rather than approving anybody's conduct.
members._gloss: of laws and regulations; designed to protect trade and commerce from unfair business pract

members.tone: Approves by negation - nothing foul in the play - where *sportsmanlike* names the virtue outright.
members._gloss: exhibiting or calling for sportsmanship or fair play

members.tone: Warmer and easier than *clean*, crediting fair play as a spirit brought to the contest rather than a rule left unbroken.
members._gloss: exhibiting or calling for sportsmanship or fair play

members.tone: The most casual of these, informal and light, granting the same approval with none of *sportsmanlike*'s weight.
members._gloss: exhibiting or calling for sportsmanship or fair play

members.tone: The formal member - it measures conduct against a named standard of sportsmanship instead of merely reporting, as *clean* does, that nothing foul happened.
members._gloss: exhibiting or calling for sportsmanship or fair play

members.tone: Praises a settled cast of mind rather than a single dealing - the impartiality is lodged in the person.
members._gloss: of a person; just and impartial; not prejudiced

members.tone: The emphatic one - its doubled phrasing insists there is nothing left to question, where *just* simply states that the standard was met.

families.axis: cool certification that something checks out -> warm, whole-character avowal of faith in it
families._definition: worthy of trust or belief

members.tone: The plain, unhedged verdict of the family - approval stated flatly, with no warmth or ceremony added to it.
Approving with a homely, affectionate warmth that *trustworthy* keeps out, and a faint pat on the head with it.
The belief is earned by checking out against the facts, so the praise is for genuineness rather than for any goodwill.
members._gloss: conforming to fact and therefore worthy of belief

members.tone: Sober and unexcited - it credits a thing with holding up under scrutiny and claims nothing more stirring than that.
members._gloss: conforming to fact and therefore worthy of belief

members.tone: Technical and bloodless, certifying a bar cleared rather than praising anything about the one who cleared it.
A quiet nod at financial standing, softer and less procedural-sounding than *creditworthy* though it settles the same question.
Praise for weight-bearing steadiness - it promises the thing will hold, where *authentic* only says it is what it claims.
Warmer and broader than *dependable*, resting the approval on the whole character rather than on any record of performance.
Elevated and absolute - constancy raised to a virtue, with a solemn ring that *dependable* never reaches for.
Technical and classifying - it marks a thing as resting on trust without any opinion on whether that trust is deserved.
Blunt and unqualified, the whole verdict compressed into one syllable that leaves no room for hedging.
members._gloss: (of persons) worthy of trust or confidence

members.tone: The participle makes the standing something conferred, where *sure* names a quality the person carries on their own.
members._gloss: (of persons) worthy of trust or confidence

families.axis: merely observable → unconcealed to the point of effrontery
families._definition: open and observable; not secret or hidden

members.tone: Flat and formal - it marks a thing as out where it can be seen and stops there, with none of the affront *barefaced* adds.
members._gloss: open and observable; not secret or hidden

members.tone: The plain everyday word for the same state, weightless where *overt* sounds like a term of art.
members._gloss: open and observable; not secret or hidden

members.tone: Blunt - concealment is not just absent but conspicuously unattempted, and the missing softening reads as harshness.
Accusatory where *bald* is merely blunt - the failure to conceal registers as nerve, something the doer should have been ashamed to show.
Stark - nothing added and nothing subtracted, so the thing stands in its own unsoftened proportions.
members._gloss: devoid of elaboration or diminution or concealment; bare and pure

members.tone: Coarser-grained than *naked* - unworked rather than merely stripped, with the roughness of the thing left on it.
members._gloss: devoid of elaboration or diminution or concealment; bare and pure

members.tone: Names concealment in order to deny it, so what is plain to see carries the sense of something that could have been hidden and was not.
Purely descriptive and the mildest of the set - it reports what the eye catches, without implying anything was ever kept back.

families.axis: bare report that nothing limits it → emphatic refusal to admit any reservation or exception
families._definition: not limited or restricted

members.tone: The bare statement of the case — nothing limits or restricts the thing — with none of the insistence *categorical* puts behind it.
Formal and clipped, it shuts the door on reservations like a ruling handed down, where *unqualified* merely reports that there are none.
members._gloss: not modified or restricted by reservations

members.tone: The unclipped form of *categoric*, and the extra syllable lands as extra weight: reservations are not merely absent but refused.
members._gloss: not modified or restricted by reservations

members.tone: Blunt and monosyllabic — the refusal of reservations delivered as a door shutting, where *categorical* delivers it as a pronouncement.
members._gloss: not modified or restricted by reservations

members.tone: Formal and absolute, it presents the missing reservations as terms deliberately not imposed rather than as *flat*'s curt refusal to entertain them.
members._gloss: not modified or restricted by reservations

members.tone: Faintly approving — freedom from qualifications felt as tidiness, nothing left clinging, where *unqualified* only records that nothing is attached.
The same freedom as *clean*, but as an unobstructed way through rather than a tidy finish: nothing in the way rather than nothing left over.

members._gloss: used of a quantity or amount (especially of money) for emphasis
members._skip_reason: gloss is a usage restriction, not a definition

members.tone: Emphatic and forceful, it presses the thing all the way through with no exception admitted, well past *unqualified*'s bare report.
Informal and plain-spoken, it admits no reservation or exception exactly as *outright* does, but without the ceremony.
Reads as sheer extent — nothing bounds the thing — where *outright* reads as manner, nothing qualifying it.

families.axis: neutral placement on a scale of rank → dismissive verdict of standing beneath others
families._definition: of or characteristic of low rank or importance

members.tone: The bare comparative of the set: it grades a thing below others and lets the ranking itself carry the sting, where *humble* names the same position without grading it.
members._gloss: of or characteristic of low rank or importance

members.tone: Names low station with a quiet grace, so the lowness reads as unpretending rather than deficient.
members._gloss: low or inferior in station or quality

members.tone: The blunt monosyllable for that station, stating the bottom position flatly and with none of the softening in *humble*.
members._gloss: low or inferior in station or quality

members.tone: Adds a meek, faintly literary air to the low position, so it sounds borne rather than merely recorded.
members._gloss: low or inferior in station or quality

members.tone: The tactful word for the same lowness, declining to call it poor and leaving the thing its dignity.
members._gloss: low or inferior in station or quality

members.tone: Shrinks rather than ranks, so the low quality registers as insignificance instead of a place on a ladder.
members._gloss: low or inferior in station or quality

members.tone: Damns by withholding: it refuses praise rather than delivering a charge, and the refusal is the verdict.
members._gloss: fairly poor to not very good

members.tone: Purely positional, marking a rung on a scale of rank without judging the worth of whatever stands there.
members._gloss: at a low level in rank or importance

members.tone: A coordinate rather than a verdict, fixing a point between top and bottom and claiming nothing about quality.
The strongest of the set: the low standing is the outcome of a contest already decisively lost, so the word carries the humiliation of the comparison.
members._gloss: decisively surpassed by something else so as to appear to be of a lower class

families.axis: bare description of mental engagement → approving claim of cultivation
families._definition: appealing to or using the intellect

members.tone: The plain term of the family - it names the faculty being engaged and passes no verdict on it.
members._gloss: appealing to or using the intellect

members.tone: Makes the cultivation conspicuous, so the compliment carries an edge *intellectual* does not.
The same claim to high cultivation as *highbrow*, but the participial form sits heavier and stiffer.
Positional rather than approving - it places the source of the thinking in the intellect as against experience.
members._gloss: having its source in or being guided by the intellect (as distinguished from experience or

members.tone: Quieter and warmer than *intellectual* - a mind given over to its own concerns rather than one showing power.
members._gloss: devoted to matters of the mind

members.tone: The barest approval here - it grants appeal to the mind without characterizing that appeal at all.
Weightier than *good* for the same appeal to the mind, casting it as demanding rather than merely worth having.
The warmest of these - it treats appeal to the intellect as refinement rather than plain substance.

families.axis: bare possession of the reasoning faculty → reason praised as sound judgment
families._definition: consistent with or based on or using reason

members.tone: Approves by pointing at the grounds - the thing rests on reason - where *reasonable* praises the quality of the judgment actually reached.
members._gloss: consistent with or based on or using reason

members.tone: Praise at its lowest setting: the thought holds together and comes out clear, a floor cleared rather than the brightness *lucid* claims.
members._gloss: capable of thinking and expressing yourself in a clear and consistent manner

members.tone: Dry, near-technical commendation - the clear consistent thinking treated as something that works by rule, with none of *lucid*'s warmth.
members._gloss: capable of thinking and expressing yourself in a clear and consistent manner

members.tone: The warmest of the three: the same clear consistent thinking praised as brightness, where *coherent* merely reports that it hangs together.
members._gloss: capable of thinking and expressing yourself in a clear and consistent manner

members.tone: Flatly descriptive - records that the mythical element is gone without approving or regretting its removal.
Carries no more judgment than *demythologized*: the stripping of myth is stated, not celebrated or mourned.
Turns the bare endowment into a compliment, where *reasoning* and *thinking* only register that the capacity is there.
members._gloss: endowed with the capacity to reason

members.tone: Purely descriptive - states that the faculty is present and stops, extending none of the credit *intelligent* does for it.
members._gloss: endowed with the capacity to reason

members.tone: Neutral in the way *reasoning* is, marking the capacity as a plain attribute rather than a merit.
members._gloss: endowed with the capacity to reason

members.tone: Solid approval of judgment exercised well, going past *rational*'s weaker claim that reason was involved at all.
members._gloss: marked by sound judgment; having good reason

members.tone: The same sound judgment, but pitched as the bar a mind must clear rather than a distinction it earns, which gives it a weight *reasonable* has not.
members._gloss: marked by sound judgment; having good reason

families.axis: plain and broad, the mind is involved → technical and exact, the mind rather than the body is the source
families._definition: involving the mind or an intellectual process

members.tone: The plainest of these, taking in any process the mind performs without the technical precision *psychological* carries.
members._gloss: involving the mind or an intellectual process

members.tone: Points at the mind as the thing engaged, in a register more elevated than *mental* - a label for the domain rather than a verdict on the work done in it.
members._gloss: of or associated with or requiring the use of the mind

members.tone: Points at the mind as the faculty at work rather than at the soundness of what it produces, making it a label and not a verdict.
members._gloss: of or associated with or requiring the use of the mind

members.tone: The most abstract and learned of the set, naming mind-work in a lofty register that *mental* keeps flat.
members._gloss: of or associated with or requiring the use of the mind

members.tone: Names not the mind itself but the kind of effect that lands there, real in force with nothing tangible behind it.
members._gloss: psychological rather than physical or tangible in effect

members.tone: Reaches in both directions at once, covering what the mind acts on and what acts on the mind, where *psychogenic* narrows to where a thing began.
members._gloss: affecting or influenced by the human mind

members.tone: The heavier, more formal twin of *psychic*, identical in what it covers and stiffer in the saying.
members._gloss: affecting or influenced by the human mind

members.tone: Technical and exact about causation, placing the starting point in the mind rather than the body instead of merely sorting by nature.
members._gloss: mental or emotional rather than physiological in origin

members.tone: The workaday technical term here, sorting a thing by what it is in nature rather than, as *psychogenic* does, by where it came from.
members._gloss: mental or emotional as opposed to physical in nature

families.axis: involving as few as two nations → covering the whole earth or rising above national boundaries
families._definition: concerning or belonging to all or at least two or more nations

members.tone: Neutral and minimal in its demand — two nations are enough to satisfy it, where *global* asks for the whole earth.
members._gloss: concerning or belonging to all or at least two or more nations

members.tone: The unmarked word for whole-earth extent, and the one that sets that extent against the narrow and the provincial.
members._gloss: involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope

members.tone: Covers the same whole-earth extent as *global* but with a grander, more astronomical ring to it.
members._gloss: involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope

members.tone: A bare noun pressed into adjective duty, flat and workmanlike where *global* sounds considered.
members._gloss: involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope

members.tone: Puts the weight on reach stretching across the earth rather than on the earth as a single whole, which *global* implies.
members._gloss: involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope

members.tone: The hyphenated form of *worldwide*, identical in force and a shade more deliberate on the page.
members._gloss: involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope

members.tone: Names a commitment rather than an extent — it says where someone stands, not how far something reaches, as *international* does.
The longer form, stiffer and more label-like than *internationalist* without adding to the stance it names.
Plain and countable — several nations or nationalities added together, where *international* needs only a relation between two.
members._gloss: involving or operating in several nations or nationalities

members.tone: Frames the same several-nation range as crossing the lines rather than summing them up, as *multinational* does.
members._gloss: involving or operating in several nations or nationalities

members.tone: Sets the thing above national boundaries and interests rather than merely across them, a step beyond *transnational*.
members._gloss: transcending established national boundaries or spheres of interest

families.axis: confidence restored or plainly held → confidence carried past what warrants it
families._definition: having or marked by confidence or assurance

members.tone: The plain baseline of the family, reporting that the assurance is there without passing any verdict on whether it is warranted.
members._gloss: having or marked by confidence or assurance

members.tone: Shifts from the inner state to the visible one, crediting a confidence you can see in the bearing where *confident* merely records it.
Jeering and informal - the excess is not diagnosed but mocked, a swagger the word refuses to take seriously beside the flat *overconfident*.
The straight clinical name for the fault, marking the confidence as more than warranted and leaving the derision to *cocksure*.
The mildest carrier of that same excess, an everyday word that lets the overreach register as a shrug rather than an accusation.
Confidence handed back rather than held all along - the settled calm of anxiety lifted, where the rest of the family says nothing about anything having been shaken.
members._gloss: having confidence restored; freed from anxiety

members.tone: Turns the poise inward onto one's own worth and lets it show as composure, steadier-sounding than the bare *confident*.
members._gloss: showing poise and confidence in your own worth

members.tone: The plainest label for that same belief in one's own worth, stating it where *self-assured* leans on the outward steadiness.
members._gloss: showing poise and confidence in your own worth

families.axis: offensive or unpleasant → actively malicious
families._definition: offensive or even (of persons) malicious

members.tone: Condemns without naming the fault, covering plain offensiveness and shading into outright ill will, where *hateful* puts the malice at the centre.
Absolute rather than pointed - the condemnation is total in degree where *nasty* keeps a needling edge.
Contempt by way of defilement - it treats what it hits as unclean rather than merely offensive, a heavier verdict than *grotty*.
The disgust in *dirty* pushed to its limit, vileness so thorough it lands as a moral verdict.
Contempt thrown off casually - the despising is real but carries none of the weight that *filthy* brings to it.
British and slangy, it registers offensiveness as squalid distaste rather than the moral condemnation in *filthy*.
Makes ill will the whole of the charge, naming the malice itself where *nasty* only shades toward it.
The plainest word for malice, stating the ill will flatly where *hateful* makes it sound monstrous.

families.axis: barely tolerable sufficiency → complete, worry-dissolving satisfaction
families._definition: giving satisfaction

members.tone: Approval delivered as a finding rather than a compliment — it certifies that satisfaction was given, where *fine* simply grants it.
Cool and measuring — it grants acceptability and stops there, withholding the warmth *fine* carries.
Acceptance with the bar still visible underneath it: the thing gets through, where *adequate* says it measures up.
A colloquial shrug whose own hedging spreads the verdict between fair and middling instead of landing on either.
The most grudging of these acceptances, framing the acceptable thing as something borne, where *passable* at least lets it through clean.
A plain all-clear — it reports that nothing is amiss rather than that anything is good, a smaller claim than *copacetic* makes.
members._gloss: being satisfactory or in satisfactory condition

members.tone: Brisk and unqualified: one syllable that closes the question of whether the thing will do, with none of *satisfactory*'s weighing.
members._gloss: being satisfactory or in satisfactory condition

members.tone: The barest possible grant of sufficiency — two letters conceding the thing is in order, without a particle of the warmth in *fine*.
members._gloss: being satisfactory or in satisfactory condition

members.tone: The spelled-out form, sitting in a sentence as a word rather than a mark, with the same flat sufficiency as *ok*.
members._gloss: being satisfactory or in satisfactory condition

members.tone: Breezy slang whose bounce overshoots the modest thing it reports — all is in order, announced as though it were a delight.
members._gloss: being satisfactory or in satisfactory condition

members.tone: Slangy assent that approves by declining to object; the ease is the point, where *fine* merely settles the matter.
members._gloss: being satisfactory or in satisfactory condition

members.tone: The same untroubled sufficiency in a spelling flagged as nonstandard, and that flag is the whole of what separates it from *all right*.
Warm and aimed at the worrier — it quiets a mind rather than removing what alarmed it, softer than the lift in *cheering*.
Raises rather than soothes: it clears worry by lifting the spirits, where *comforting* clears it by settling them.
Relief supplied by sufficiency itself — the worry lifts because the thing proves enough, where *comforting* works on the person instead.
Slangy and total — it closes off every remaining objection, where *all right* reports only that none has surfaced.

families.axis: bare nearness or resemblance → settled, felt intimacy
families._definition: close in relevance or relationship

members.tone: The plain measure of nearness in relevance or relationship, stating the proximity without the warmth or the suspicion the rest of the set add.
Measuring and cool - it rates a resemblance as very close while stopping short of calling it the same thing.
Blunter than *approximate* for the same degree of resemblance - it asserts the likeness flatly instead of hedging it.
Warm and a little grand - closeness with good cheer inside it, heartier than the merely matey *chummy*.
Informal and light - friendly association on easy terms, without the depth *intimate* claims.
The doubled informal form makes the closeness emphatic and knowing where *chummy* keeps it mild.
Blunt informal shorthand for being closely associated, reporting the tie without the warmth *chummy* supplies.
Approving of cohesion - the bond is what holds people together, structural where *dear* is personal.
members._gloss: held together as by social or cultural ties

members.tone: The open form spells the binding out and reads more deliberate and descriptive than the compact *close-knit*.
members._gloss: held together as by social or cultural ties

members.tone: Closeness figured as trust - what passes inside it is entrusted, where *chummy* is merely companionable.
Insinuating - the closeness is treated as connivance, so the snugness of the word becomes the accusation.
The British spelling carrying the same imputation of connivance, warmth named in order to be distrusted.
Affectionate and avowed - the close relationship is felt as fondness, where *thick* merely reports the association.
members._gloss: with or in a close or intimate relationship

members.tone: Plain and understated for the same close relationship - it vouches for the bond rather than professing feeling as *dear* does.
members._gloss: with or in a close or intimate relationship

members.tone: Closeness worn as ease - an established friendship that needs no ceremony, less ardent than *intimate*.
members._gloss: having mutual interests or affections; of established friendship

members.tone: The strongest claim in the set - mutual affection and settled friendship, closer and more private than *familiar*.
members._gloss: having mutual interests or affections; of established friendship

families.axis: a bare statement that something is not there → total emptiness, or existence ended altogether
families._definition: not having existence or being or actuality

members.tone: Flat and absolute - the thing simply has no being, without the sense in *missing* that it was expected somewhere.
members._gloss: not having existence or being or actuality

members.tone: Registers the nonexistence as a deficiency rather than a bare fact, which *absent* does not.
Neutral and faintly formal, stating the nonexistence with none of the note of shortfall in *lacking*.
Points at the gap - the nonexistence is felt as a hole where something belonged.
The most judging of these - the nonexistence reads as falling short of a mark, not merely as nothing being there.
Bleak - the total lack is a desolate condition rather than the cool fact *devoid* states.
Severe - the complete lack sounds like deprivation, emptiness that hurts.
Formal and absolute, naming total emptiness while passing no verdict on it.
The approving member - the same complete lack is a relief, the absent thing one you are better off without.
Light and wry - complete absence made to sound blameless, the opposite colouring to *destitute*.
Technical and dry - marks the thing as gone through loss or destruction and judges nothing about it.
members._gloss: no longer existing or inaccessible through loss or destruction

members.tone: Carries the drama of a disappearance - existence not merely denied but ended, where *nonexistent* implies no before.

families.axis: easy to see → so complete it needs no proof or explanation
families._definition: easily perceived and understood

members.tone: The flat baseline of the group: a thing takes no effort to see or grasp, without *palpable*'s pressure or *axiomatic*'s claim about proof.
The lightest way here of saying the thing shows itself — it reports the showing rather than pressing it, unlike *unmistakable*.
members._gloss: clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment

members.tone: Plain and unemphatic: the thing is simply there to be seen, with none of the display *manifest* makes of it.
members._gloss: clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment

members.tone: Formal and expansive — the thing does not merely show but puts itself on show, a grander word than *evident* for the same clarity.
members._gloss: clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment

members.tone: Pushes the showing towards touch, so the thing is felt as much as seen — heavier in the hand than *apparent*.
members._gloss: clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment

members.tone: Formal and declarative: the clarity is stated as settled fact rather than offered as an impression, where *palpable* appeals to the senses.
members._gloss: clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment

members.tone: The homeliest word here — clarity with no ceremony at all, exactly what *manifest* supplies in excess.
members._gloss: clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment

members.tone: Works by ruling out the alternative: the thing cannot be read as anything else, a firmer guarantee than *apparent* gives.
members._gloss: clearly revealed to the mind or the senses or judgment

members.tone: Formal and absolute — the thing stands with no argument put behind it, a larger claim than being merely *evident*.
The plainer word for the same standing as *axiomatic*: the thing carries its own warrant and asks for none to be brought.
An ordinary-language phrase that concedes the standing rather than asserting it — the thing passes without argument instead of being shown to need none.
Shifts from what is seen to what can be shown: the clarity is available on demand rather than immediate, unlike *obvious*.
members._gloss: capable of being demonstrated or proved

members.tone: The blunter twin of *demonstrable*, resting the whole claim on proof being possible.
members._gloss: capable of being demonstrated or proved

members.tone: Technical and unemphatic — it flags the thing as clearly there and does nothing more with it, where *manifest* makes a display.
Informal and conclusive: the obviousness is enough to settle the matter, not merely to be seen — a force *plain* never reaches.
members._gloss: so obvious as to be easily solved or decided

members.tone: The thing supplies its own account, so nothing need be added to it — a different job from *obvious*, which only says it is easy to grasp.

families.axis: plainly high in price → priced past what it was worth paying
families._definition: high in price or charging high prices

members.tone: The plain word for a high price, stating the fact without deciding whether the price is deserved.
members._gloss: high in price or charging high prices

members.tone: Steps up from *expensive* to a price high enough to be remarkable, still with no verdict attached to it.
Carries the same very-high price as *big-ticket* in a flatter, more transactional ring.
Weightier than *high-priced*, the price felt as a cost borne rather than a number quoted.
British, and softer than *costly* — the same high price delivered in an everyday, conversational word.
Flat and purely descriptive: it says the price is high and refuses any attitude toward it.
Informal and faintly grumbling — the high price registered as a small complaint rather than a measurement.
The same informal grumble as *pricey* in a clipped spelling, with no shift in force.
Moves the price off money entirely onto loss or sacrifice, naming what something took without condemning it.
Judgement rather than measurement — it sets the price against the value and finds it unearned.

families.axis: quietly held dear → loved with the rapture owed a god
families._definition: held dear

members.tone: The plain word for holding dear, stating the fact of the feeling without measuring its heat, where *adored* measures nothing else.
Regard rather than warmth - the approval answers to what the object is, so it can be offered coolly and from a distance.
Love at its most rapturous, pitched as high as devotion to a god and far past anything *loved* claims.
members._gloss: regarded with deep or rapturous love (especially as if for a god)

members.tone: Sets the loved one above the lover - rapture that looks up at what it loves.
members._gloss: regarded with deep or rapturous love (especially as if for a god)

members.tone: The same raising of the loved one into an object of worship, love felt as reverence rather than as fondness.
members._gloss: regarded with deep or rapturous love (especially as if for a god)

members.tone: States outright the comparison the others only lean on: love offered as if to a god.
members._gloss: regarded with deep or rapturous love (especially as if for a god)

members.tone: Formal and settled - it names the one dearly loved instead of reporting a feeling, which gives it a weight *darling* has none of.
Fond and light, dear love spoken as endearment; it can be said playfully where *beloved* cannot.
The quiet, unemphatic way to say dearly loved - small in sound and large in meaning.
Names the favorite by an image rather than by any word for feeling, so the approval reads as preference rather than passion.
Marks the one singled out for favor - flattering about standing, not about the depth of love in *adored*.
A figurative way of calling someone the favorite: approval that consists in being picked out.
Fond affection with tending in it - the feeling is kept up, not merely felt.
members._gloss: characterized by feeling or showing fond affection for

members.tone: Turns fond affection into worth, so the one held is valued as much as loved.
members._gloss: characterized by feeling or showing fond affection for

members.tone: Affection that hoards - what is felt fondly is also kept and guarded, where *cherished* only tends it.
members._gloss: characterized by feeling or showing fond affection for

members.tone: The plainest of these - fond affection showing itself as desire for the one held, with none of the ceremony of *treasured*.
members._gloss: characterized by feeling or showing fond affection for

families.axis: faint, matter-of-fact approval → superlative delight
families._definition: giving pleasure and satisfaction

members.tone: Plain, unraised approval - it states the pleasure and satisfaction given and leaves it there, where *delightful* insists.
Approval with esteem in it - it asks you to look up at the thing rather than merely enjoy it, a graver register than *charming*.
Warm and disarming - the pleasure sounds like an appeal exerted on you, gentler than *delightful*'s enthusiasm.
Enthusiastic - the pleasure is raised to a high pitch and given an edge of entertainment that *pleasing* lacks.
Savouring - it makes high pleasure sound like something relished, richer and more indulgent than *delightful*.
Understated to the edge of neutrality - it concedes that pleasure is afforded without any warmth of praise behind it.
Extravagant - praise pitched at the ceiling and past plausibility, far louder than *pleasing*.
Slangy and clipped - the same top-of-the-scale praise as *fabulous*, tossed off rather than declared.
All-purpose and colourless - it grants no more than the capacity to please, where *pleasing* reports pleasure actually given.
Sober and faintly formal - it puts the pleasure in the mind or the feelings rather than on the surface, weightier than *sweet*.
members._gloss: pleasing to the mind or feeling

members.tone: Warm and informal - the same inward pleasure as *gratifying*, but tender and unguarded rather than composed.
members._gloss: pleasing to the mind or feeling

members.tone: It measures pleasing by the favour won rather than by the pleasure given, which tilts it away from praising the thing at all, unlike *charming*.

families.axis: difficulty framed as a stretch worth making → difficulty framed as a predicament no one would want
families._definition: not easy; requiring great physical or mental effort to accomplish or comprehend or endure

members.tone: Flat and unemotive - it registers that effort is required to do, grasp or bear the thing, without hinting whether that effort is worth spending, as *challenging* does.
members._gloss: not easy; requiring great physical or mental effort to accomplish or comprehend or endure

members.tone: The blunt, plain-spoken version of *difficult* for the same demand, taking effort of body, mind or endurance as it comes and softening none of it.
members._gloss: not easy; requiring great physical or mental effort to accomplish or comprehend or endure

members.tone: Approving - it treats the full call on your abilities and resources as a reach worth making rather than a weight to be borne.
members._gloss: requiring full use of your abilities or resources

members.tone: Turns that same full call on everything you have into an invitation to rise to it, so the demand reads as a spur where *problematic* reads as a fault.
members._gloss: requiring full use of your abilities or resources

members.tone: Formal and weighty - it dwells on the sustained mental effort and skill the thing exacts before it will be accomplished, heavier in the mouth than *hard*.
members._gloss: difficult to accomplish; demanding considerable mental effort and skill

members.tone: Mildly disapproving - the difficulty sits in the handling, since any move you make risks the pain or embarrassment the thing carries.
members._gloss: hard to deal with; especially causing pain or embarrassment

members.tone: Puts the discomfort squarely on the face of whoever has to deal with it, naming the exposure that *awkward* leaves implied.
members._gloss: hard to deal with; especially causing pain or embarrassment

members.tone: Informal - it makes the trouble something you are caught in and cannot step cleanly out of, lighter in tone than *unenviable* and no easier to escape.
members._gloss: hard to deal with; especially causing pain or embarrassment

members.tone: An understated verdict that condemns by observation - the thing is framed as unwished-for, and the word damns it without raising its voice.
members._gloss: hard to deal with; especially causing pain or embarrassment

members.tone: Puts the great mental demand where understanding fails - the thing does not merely resist solution, it leaves you at a loss.
members._gloss: making great mental demands; hard to comprehend or solve or believe

members.tone: The difficulty is in the slipping away: comprehension seems within reach and will not close on it, unlike the frank obstruction of *knotty*.
members._gloss: making great mental demands; hard to comprehend or solve or believe

members.tone: Gives the mental demand a shape - a tangle to be picked apart strand by strand, rather than the blank wall of *baffling*.
members._gloss: making great mental demands; hard to comprehend or solve or believe

members.tone: Labels the demanding thing a problem outright, a mild verdict against it where *tough* only reports the demand.
members._gloss: making great mental demands; hard to comprehend or solve or believe

members.tone: Stiffer and more formal than *problematic* for the same verdict, its extra syllable adding weight rather than force.
members._gloss: making great mental demands; hard to comprehend or solve or believe

members.tone: Informal and almost respectful of the difficulty - it sizes up the mental demand as something to be taken on and says nothing against it.
members._gloss: making great mental demands; hard to comprehend or solve or believe

members.tone: Warns of a snare - the difficulty is concealed until you are into it, so the word marks the thing as harder than it lets on.

families.axis: requiring more than usual → severe and impossible to satisfy
families._definition: requiring more than usually expected or thought due; especially great patience and effort and skill

members.tone: Plain and unheated - it names the size of what is asked without ruling on whether asking it is fair, where *hard-to-please* has already convicted someone.
members._gloss: requiring more than usually expected or thought due; especially great patience and effort

members.tone: The formal, cool-surfaced twin of *exacting* - the same insistence on precision, pitched at a distance.
Puts the weight on the standard itself, so the precision reads as a measure to be met rather than a temper to be humoured.
Disparaging - the fussiness makes the demand a flaw in the person, which *exacting* never does.
The open spelling carries the same verdict but reads as a running remark about someone rather than a label fixed to them.
Belittling and intimate - the excess is emotional appetite, and the word tips toward pity where *hard-to-please* stays at irritation.
members._gloss: demanding or needing attention, affection, or reassurance to an excessive degree

members.tone: Approving - the strictness registers as discipline worth having, where *tight* only pinches.
members._gloss: demanding strict attention to rules and procedures

members.tone: Cool and administrative, stating how tightly the rules bind without either praising or resenting the binding.
members._gloss: demanding strict attention to rules and procedures

members.tone: The informal one, and the constriction is felt - the rules squeeze rather than uphold anything.
members._gloss: demanding strict attention to rules and procedures

members.tone: Adds a forbidding manner to the severity - the unrelenting demand arrives with a chill that *strict* does not carry.
members._gloss: severe and unremitting in making demands

members.tone: The flat word for the same unrelenting severity, stating it without colouring it as harshness.
members._gloss: severe and unremitting in making demands

families.axis: a light leaning that could go either way → a tendency fixed hard enough to be counted on
families._definition: (often followed by ‘to’) having a preference, disposition, or tendency

members.tone: Mild and non-committal - the leaning is stated lightly enough to leave room for doing otherwise, where *prone* fixes it in place.
members._gloss: (often followed by ‘to’) having a preference, disposition, or tendency

members.tone: Neutral but predictive - it treats the leaning as a matter of the subject's nature, so what follows sounds expected rather than merely possible.
Formal and dry - the leaning sounds like a settled arrangement of temperament rather than an appetite, cooler than *given*.
Blunt and settled - the disposition sounds ingrained rather than merely present, heavier and more everyday than *disposed*.

Warm - the leaning is felt as liking rather than as mere direction, which is what lifts it clear of *inclined*.

members.tone: Lighter and more indulgent than *fond* - it casts the strong liking as a weakness cheerfully admitted.
members._gloss: (followed by ‘of’ or ‘to’) having a strong preference or liking for

families.axis: advantage merely registered → good actively credited
families._definition: giving an advantage

members.tone: Cool, calculating approval — it rates a thing by the edge it hands you and says nothing about whether that edge is deserved or does any good.
Warmer than *advantageous*: the advantage reads as conditions tilting your way rather than as an edge coldly reckoned up.
The British spelling of *favorable*, carrying the identical tilt-in-your-favour approval with no shift in force.
Formal and firmly approving — it credits the thing with actually improving matters, where *advantageous* only counts the edge gained.

families.axis: mildly preferable → hotly craved
families._definition: worth having or seeking or achieving

members._gloss: worth having or seeking or achieving
